title: Tegument
summary: TEG'UMENT, noun [Latin tegumentum, from tego, to cover.] A cover or covering; seldom used except in reference to the covering of a living body. [See Integument.]

inlines.v: TEG'UMENT, noun [Latin tegumentum, from tego, to cover.] A cover or covering; seldom used except in reference to the covering of a living body. [See Integument.]
